text_en: Now when David and his men came to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the Negeb and on Ziklag. They had attacked Ziklag, burned it down,
text_cn: 当达味和他的人第三天来到漆刻拉格时，阿玛肋克人已侵入乃革布和漆刻拉格，将漆刻拉格洗劫，放火烧了，

text_en: and taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great; they killed none of them, but carried them off, and went their way.
text_cn: 将城中的妇女，以及所有的老幼，都掳了去；但没有杀人，只将他们掳走，回返原路。

text_en: When David and his men came to the city, they found it burned down, and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive.
text_cn: 达味和他的人来到城旁，见城已被火烧毁，他们的妻子儿女尽被掳去，

text_en: Then David and the people who were with him raised their voices and wept, until they had no more strength to weep.
text_cn: 遂放声大哭，直哭得声嘶力竭。

text_en: David’s two wives also had been taken captive, Ahinoam of Jezreel, and Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel.
text_cn: 达味的两个妻子：依次勒耳人阿希诺罕和曾作加尔默耳人纳巴耳妻子的阿彼盖耳，也被掳去了。

text_en: David was in great danger; for the people spoke of stoning him, because all the people were bitter in spirit for their sons and daughters. But David strengthened himself in the Lord his God.
text_cn: 达味陷入窘境，因为人民各为自己的儿女非常痛心，都说要用石头打死他；但是达味更加坚固依靠上主，他的天主。

text_en: David said to the priest Abiathar son of Ahimelech, “Bring me the ephod. ” So Abiathar brought the ephod to David.
text_cn: 达味对阿希默肋客的儿子厄贝雅塔尔司祭说：“请你将‘厄弗得’给我拿来！”厄贝雅塔尔就将‘厄弗得’给达味拿了来。

text_en: David inquired of the Lord , “Shall I pursue this band? Shall I overtake them? ” He answered him, “Pursue; for you shall surely overtake and shall surely rescue. ”
text_cn: 达味求问上主说：“我该追赶这群土匪吗？我追得上吗？”上主答说：“你去追赶，必能追上，能救回一切。”

text_en: So David set out, he and the six hundred men who were with him. They came to the Wadi Besor, where those stayed who were left behind.
text_cn: 达味和随从他的六百人于是立即出发，到了贝索尔河。

text_en: But David went on with the pursuit, he and four hundred men; two hundred stayed behind, too exhausted to cross the Wadi Besor.
text_cn: 达味带着四百人仍向前追赶，其余二百人，因为过于疲倦，不能过贝索尔河，就住下了。

text_en: In the open country they found an Egyptian, and brought him to David. They gave him bread and he ate; they gave him water to drink;
text_cn: 有人在田间遇见了一个埃及人，把他领到达味前，给他饭吃，给他水喝，

text_en: they also gave him a piece of fig cake and two clusters of raisins. When he had eaten, his spirit revived; for he had not eaten bread or drunk water for three days and three nights.
text_cn: 又给他一块无花果饼，两串干葡萄；他吃了后，精神就恢复了，因为他已三天三夜没有吃饭喝水了。

text_en: Then David said to him, “To whom do you belong? Where are you from? ” He said, “I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite. My master left me behind because I fell sick three days ago.
text_cn: 达味问他说：“你是谁的人，你是哪里的？”他答说：“我是个埃及少年，为一个阿玛肋克人做奴隶，因为我害病，我主人抛弃我已三天了。

text_en: We had made a raid on the Negeb of the Cherethites and on that which belongs to Judah and on the Negeb of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag down. ”
text_cn: 我们侵袭了革勒提人的南部， 犹大的南部和加肋布的南部，放火烧了漆刻拉格。”

text_en: David said to him, “Will you take me down to this raiding party? ” He said, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me, or hand me over to my master, and I will take you down to them. ”
text_cn: 达味问他说：“你能领我下到这群土匪那里去吗？”他答说：“你要指着天主给我起誓：不杀我，也不将我交在我主人手里，那么我就领你下到这群土匪那里去。”达味对他起了誓，

text_en: When he had taken him down, they were spread out all over the ground, eating and drinking and dancing, because of the great amount of spoil they had taken from the land of the Philistines and from the land of Judah.
text_cn: 他便领他下去了。看，土匪都散在各处，正在吃喝，庆祝他们从培肋舍特地方和犹大地方抢来的大批胜利品。

text_en: David attacked them from twilight until the evening of the next day. Not one of them escaped, except four hundred young men, who mounted camels and fled.
text_cn: 达味从天亮直到晚上，击杀他们，消灭他们，除四百骑骆驼逃走的士兵外，一个也没有逃脱。

text_en: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken; and David rescued his two wives.
text_cn: 凡阿玛肋克人所掳去的，达味都救了回来，也救回了他的两个妻子。

text_en: Nothing was missing, whether small or great, sons or daughters, spoil or anything that had been taken; David brought back everything.
text_cn: 凡被掳去的，不论老幼，不论子女，不论什么财物，一个也不缺，达味全都夺了回来。

text_en: David also captured all the flocks and herds, which were driven ahead of the other cattle; people said, “This is David’s spoil. ”
text_cn: 他们夺回了所有的牛羊，牵到达味前说：“这是达味的战利品。”

text_en: Then David came to the two hundred men who had been too exhausted to follow David, and who had been left at the Wadi Besor. They went out to meet David and to meet the people who were with him. When David drew near to the people he saluted them.
text_cn: 达味回到那二百人那里，他们因为走路疲乏，不能跟着去，达味就叫他们停留在贝索尔河旁，──这些人就前来欢迎达味和跟随他的军人，达味和军人也上前去向他们请安。

text_en: Then all the corrupt and worthless fellows among the men who had gone with David said, “Because they did not go with us, we will not give them any of the spoil that we have recovered, except that each man may take his wife and children, and leave. ”
text_cn: 同达味前去的人中，有些不良分子和无赖之徒高声嚷说：“他们既然没有与我们同去，我们所救回来的财物，什么也不要分给他们，只让他们各自带自己的妻子和儿女回去。”

text_en: But David said, “You shall not do so, my brothers, with what the Lord has given us; he has preserved us and handed over to us the raiding party that attacked us.
text_cn: 达味就说：“兄弟们，上主既然这样恩待我们，保护我们，把这群前来攻击我们的土匪，交在我们手里，你们决不能这样做。

text_en: Who would listen to you in this matter? For the share of the one who goes down into the battle shall be the same as the share of the one who stays by the baggage; they shall share alike. ”
text_cn: 在这件事上，谁能依从你们呢？那下去打仗的得多少，那留下看守辎重的，也得多少；大家应当平分！”

text_en: From that day forward he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel; it continues to the present day.
text_cn: 从那天起，达味给以色列立定了这项至今有效的规矩和法律。

text_en: When David came to Ziklag, he sent part of the spoil to his friends, the elders of Judah, saying, “Here is a present for you from the spoil of the enemies of the Lord ”;
text_cn: 达味回到漆刻拉格，照犹大所有的城邑，从胜利品中拿了些分给他们的长老说：“请看！这是由上主敌人的财物中，给你们分送的礼物。”

text_en: it was for those in Bethel, in Ramoth of the Negeb, in Jattir,
text_cn: 就是给了那些在贝突耳的，在辣玛南方的，在雅提尔的，

text_en: in Aroer, in Siphmoth, in Eshtemoa,
text_cn: 在阿辣辣的，在息弗摩特的，在厄市特摩的，

text_en: in Racal, in the towns of the Jerahmeelites, in the towns of the Kenites,
text_cn: 在加尔默耳的，在耶辣默耳人城中的，在刻尼人城中的，

text_en: in Hormah, in Bor-ashan, in Athach,
text_cn: 在曷尔玛的，在波尔阿商的，在阿塔客的，

text_en: in Hebron, all the places where David and his men had roamed.
text_cn: 在赫贝龙的长老，也给了在达味和他的人民曾经漂流过的地方的人。
